recipes.title: Banana Greek Yogurt Protein Brownies

items.i: dark chocolate chips (optional, for the top)

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Mash the bananas, then whisk in the eggs and Greek yogurt.
Add the chocolate protein powder, cocoa powder and baking powder and mix well into a smooth, thick batter.
Pour into a lined baking dish, scatter with chocolate chips and bake 20–25 minutes, until just set with a fudgy center.
recipes.notes: Macros are the creator's, per brownie. The post lists ingredients without amounts or a bake time, so quantities and timing are estimated. The post's photos are AI-generated, so the real result will be denser and more banana-forward than pictured, as commenters point out.
